chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, all together from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the brothers from the mother with the grandfather. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The brothers from the mother, their prescribed share is one-third, with the grandfather.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal half-brothers when inheriting with the grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific inheritance share of maternal half-brothers (ikhwah min al-umm) as one-third when they inherit alongside the paternal grandfather (jadd), a ruling derived directly from Imam al-Sadiq (AS). It highlights the Shia jurisprudential approach to resolving potential conflicts between different categories of heirs by specifying the fixed portion for the maternal siblings in this particular configuration.
